verdict.rationale: Asana documents an official MCP server whose read tools return workspace data, so AI assistants can answer natural-language questions such as "Find all my incomplete tasks due this week" and generate summaries from Asana data. Its own AI Teammates and Asana Dash draw on Work Graph context, but the evidence frames them as agents doing work, not as a question-and-answer feature. Nothing shows answers come with citations, and the main documented Q&A path runs through an external AI client like Claude. Missing for 10: a native in-product AI Q&A experience over workspace content, documented source citations or links in answers, evidence of instant answer quality, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
